parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Radioactive decay is both spontaneous and random.

State what is meant by:

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
Strontium-90 ($^{90}_{38}\text{Sr}$) is an unstable nuclide.

The activity of a sample of $1.0 \times 10^{-9}\text{ kg}$ of strontium-90 is $5.2\text{ MBq}$.
parts.text: Determine the decay constant $\lambda$ of strontium-90.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The activity of the sample after a time of $1.0$ half lives is found to be greater than the expected $2.6\text{ MBq}$.

Suggest a possible reason for this.
